title: Human-AI Synergy in Agentic Code Review
abstract: arXiv:2603.15911v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Code review is a critical software engineering practice where developers review code changes before integration to ensure code quality, detect defects, and improve maintainability. In recent years, AI agents that can understand code context, plan review actions, and interact with development environments have been increasingly integrated into the code review process. However, there is limited empirical evidence to compare the effectiveness of AI agents and human reviewers in collaborative workflows. translated_title: 智能体化代码审查中的人机协同
translated_abstract: 代码审查是一项关键的软件工程实践，开发人员在代码集成之前审查代码变更，以确保代码质量、检测缺陷并提升可维护性。近年来，能够理解代码上下文、规划审查行动并与开发环境交互的AI智能体被越来越多地集成到代码审查流程中。然而，目前缺乏实证证据来比较AI智能体与人类审查者在协作工作流中的有效性。为了填补这一空白，我们对300个开源GitHub项目中的278,790次代码审查对话进行了大规模实证分析。在本研究中，我们旨在比较人类审查者与AI智能体所提供的反馈差异。我们研究了审查对话中的人机协作模式，以理解交互如何塑造审查结果。此外，我们分析了人类审查者和AI智能体所提供的代码建议的采纳情况。
tldr: 该论文通过对300个开源项目中278,790次代码审查对话的大规模实证分析，比较了人类审查者与AI智能体的反馈差异，揭示了人机协作模式及交互方式如何影响代码审查结果与建议采纳率。
en_tdlr: Through a large-scale empirical analysis of 278,790 code review conversations across 300 open-source GitHub projects, this paper compares the feedback differences between human reviewers and AI agents, revealing how human-AI collaboration patterns shape review outcomes and suggestion adoption.
